# How to automate new hire welcome kits (2026)

How to automate new hire welcome kits end to end: stock the kit, generate a self-serve redeem link, collect sizes and addresses, and ship globally with duties handled. Drop one link into Personio, HiBob, Workday or HubSpot and it runs itself.

Niels Vandecasteele

·June 16, 2026·7 min read

TL;DR

To automate new hire welcome kits, stock the kit, bundle it, and create a redeem campaign with a self-serve link. The hire picks a size, confirms their address, and it ships with duties handled. Paste that one link into Personio, HiBob, Workday or HubSpot.

Key takeaways

- Automate once you send around 10 kits a month - the product price is the same and shipping is usually cheaper, so it costs nothing extra.
- A single redeem link pasted into your HR system is the integration - no API project or IT build.
- The new hire self-serves their size and address on the redeem page, removing spreadsheet chasing and wrong deliveries.
- Kits ship Delivered At Place with duties pre-financed, so recipients are never billed at the door.
- Track-and-trace means even remote hires know the kit is coming and are not forgotten.
